newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab falls.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices mixed, Punjab falls.

text.p: Indian Punjab cotton varieties on Thursday fell while Gujarat cotton held steady, dealers said.
"Punjab cotton attracted fresh offerings on reports of rising new crop arrivals in the Punjab region," one dealer said.
Spot deals Bengal-deshi fell to 855/885 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) from 865/900 rupees. Punjab saw-ginned also moved down by 20/30 rupees to 1,480/1,620 rupees.
Daily new crop arrivals in the Punjab region have risen to 28-30,000 bales (170 kg each) and traders were expecting more supplies in the next few days.
Gujarat cotton was unchanged on dull trade.
